Bard.name: Verse Mastery
Bard.originalText: Verse Mastery: +5% damage on all Verses.

Bard.name: Lingering Notes
Bard.originalText: Lingering Notes: Chants last 1 extra turn after being interrupted.

Bard.name: Melodic Instinct
Bard.originalText: Melodic Instinct: +5% initiative and movement speed.

Bard.name: Echo Harmonization
Bard.originalText: Echo Harmonization: Echo effects apply +1 turn duration.

Bard.name: Performance Focus
Bard.originalText: Performance Focus: Gain 10% reduced cooldown on Bard skills when at max Crescendo.

Bard.name: Verse of Courage
Bard.originalText: Verse of Courage: A quick musical phrase that deals minor damage to a single target and grants +5% damage to an ally for 2 turns.

Bard.name: Chant of Renewal
Bard.originalText: Chant of Renewal: A sustained melody that heals nearby allies for a small amount each turn while maintained.

Bard.name: Echo of Inspiration
Bard.originalText: Echo of Inspiration: Amplifies your last performed ability, causing its effects to repeat at 50% potency next turn.

Bard.name: Dissonant Note
Bard.originalText: Dissonant Note: A jarring sound that interrupts enemy concentration and has a chance to briefly stun.

Bard.name: Bardic Knowledge
Bard.originalText: Bardic Knowledge: Passive ability that grants insight into lore, history, and cultural information encountered during adventures.

Bard.name: Fluid Tempo
Bard.originalText: Fluid Tempo: Crescendo stacks no longer drop when hit.

Bard.name: Verses Unbound
Bard.originalText: Verses Unbound: Verses can now crit, dealing x1.5 damage.

Bard.name: Chorus Shield
Bard.originalText: Chorus Shield: Using a Chant grants a minor damage shield to self and nearest ally.

Bard.name: Signature Sound
Bard.originalText: Signature Sound: Choose a single element (Fire/Ice/Lightning). Your Verses deal +10% of that type.

Bard.name: Perfect Pitch (Capstone)
Bard.originalText: Perfect Pitch (Capstone): At 5 Crescendo, Verses also apply a debuff: -10% enemy resistances for 2 turns.

Bard.name: Virtuoso's Verse
Bard.originalText: Virtuoso's Verse: An enhanced musical phrase that deals moderate damage and has a chance to apply a short debuff based on your Signature Sound element.

Bard.name: Resonant Chant
Bard.originalText: Resonant Chant: A powerful sustained melody that provides both healing and a small defensive bonus to allies in range.

Bard.name: Cascading Echo
Bard.originalText: Cascading Echo: Creates multiple echoes of your previous ability, each at diminishing potency.

Bard.name: Tempo Control
Bard.originalText: Tempo Control: Manipulates the flow of battle, slightly increasing allies' action speed while decreasing enemies' speed.

Bard.name: Harmonic Convergence
Bard.originalText: Harmonic Convergence: Consumes all Crescendo stacks to create a powerful area effect that combines damage to enemies and support for allies.

Bard.name: Song of Serenity
Bard.originalText: Song of Serenity: Nearby allies regenerate minor HP over 2 turns after a Chant.

Bard.name: Cleansing Verse
Bard.originalText: Cleansing Verse: Crescendo 5 grants group-wide status cleanse.

Bard.name: Echo of Light
Bard.originalText: Echo of Light: Echoes apply +10% healing received.

Bard.name: Divine Chorus
Bard.originalText: Divine Chorus: Party gains +1 action every 3 turns while Crescendo is active.

Bard.name: Crescendo of Hope
Bard.originalText: Finale: Crescendo of Hope: On death, performs one last healing Chant automatically. (1/day)

Bard.name: Healing Harmony
Bard.originalText: Healing Harmony: A powerful restorative melody that heals allies and has a chance to remove negative status effects.

Bard.name: Protective Verse
Bard.originalText: Protective Verse: Creates a barrier around an ally that absorbs damage and grants resistance to the next status effect.

Bard.name: Chorus of Renewal
Bard.originalText: Chorus of Renewal: Consumes all Crescendo stacks to provide a significant healing effect to all allies in range.

Bard.name: Inspiring Performance
Bard.originalText: Inspiring Performance: Boosts allies' morale, granting bonuses to attack, defense, and saving throws.

Bard.name: Symphony of Serenity
Bard.originalText: Symphony of Serenity: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of peace, healing allies over time and preventing enemies from using certain aggressive abilities.

Bard.name: Echo Reverb
Bard.originalText: Echo Reverb: Echo effects trigger a second time for 50% potency.

Bard.name: Chant Cascade
Bard.originalText: Chant Cascade: Using a Chant resets cooldown on your last Verse.

Bard.name: Encore
Bard.originalText: Encore: 20% chance a Bard skill refunds its cooldown.

Bard.name: Tempo Theft
Bard.originalText: Tempo Theft: Gain +5% action speed for each enemy affected by your Chants.

Bard.name: Grand Performance
Bard.originalText: Finale: Grand Performance: Spend 5 Crescendo to grant an extra action to all allies in range. (1/day)

Bard.name: Masterful Verse
Bard.originalText: Masterful Verse: A complex musical phrase that deals damage to multiple targets and builds Crescendo faster.

Bard.name: Tempo Manipulation
Bard.originalText: Tempo Manipulation: Alters the flow of time in a small area, speeding up allies or slowing enemies.

Bard.name: Virtuoso's Medley
Bard.originalText: Virtuoso's Medley: Combines effects of your previously used abilities into a powerful sequence.

Bard.name: Harmonic Resonance
Bard.originalText: Harmonic Resonance: Creates zones of beneficial or harmful energy based on musical notes played.

Bard.name: Symphony of Mastery
Bard.originalText: Symphony of Mastery: Ultimate ability that maximizes your Crescendo generation and allows rapid casting of multiple bard abilities in sequence.

Bard.name: Dissonant Pulse
Bard.originalText: Dissonant Pulse: Chants deal minor psychic damage each round.

Bard.name: Cacophony
Bard.originalText: Cacophony: Verses apply a stacking -5% Accuracy debuff.

Bard.name: Maddening Echo
Bard.originalText: Maddening Echo: Echoes may confuse enemies for 1 turn (25% chance).

Bard.name: Twisted Chorus
Bard.originalText: Twisted Chorus: Crescendo 5 causes enemies to suffer -10% to all saves for 2 turns.

Bard.name: Dirge of Madness
Bard.originalText: Finale: Dirge of Madness: Once per long rest, enemies in a wide area are stunned and take psychic damage based on your Crescendo stacks.

Bard.name: Verse of Agony
Bard.originalText: Verse of Agony: A painful melody that deals damage over time and reduces healing received.

Bard.name: Chant of Fear
Bard.originalText: Chant of Fear: Causes enemies to flee or fight at reduced effectiveness.

Bard.name: Discordant Echo
Bard.originalText: Discordant Echo: Corrupts the effects of your previous ability to create harmful distortions.

Bard.name: Mind-Rending Performance
Bard.originalText: Mind-Rending Performance: Deals psychic damage and has a chance to confuse or stun enemies.

Bard.name: Symphony of Madness
Bard.originalText: Symphony of Madness: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of chaotic energy, causing enemies to attack each other and suffer from hallucinations.

Cleric.name: Conviction Pool
Cleric.originalText: Conviction Pool: +2 max Conviction cap.

Cleric.name: Consecrated Ground
Cleric.originalText: Consecrated Ground: Healing allies on terrain you sanctify (via Rite) heals for +10%.

Cleric.name: Judging Light
Cleric.originalText: Judging Light: Smite deals +20% bonus damage to enemies afflicted by Cursed or Weakened effects.

Cleric.name: Fervent Ritualist
Cleric.originalText: Fervent Ritualist: +10% faster channel speed on all Rites.

Cleric.name: Invocation Attunement
Cleric.originalText: Invocation Attunement: Choose one Invocation Path (see below); gain a permanent passive tied to it.

Cleric.name: Radiance
Cleric.originalText: Radiance: +10% healing power and heals cleanse minor conditions.

Cleric.name: Judgment
Cleric.originalText: Judgment: Smites mark enemies with Judged for 2 rounds, reducing their AC by 1.

Cleric.name: Renewal
Cleric.originalText: Renewal: Healing Rites restore 5 stamina to the target.

Cleric.name: Flame
Cleric.originalText: Flame: Conviction can be consumed to ignite targets for 2 turns (fire DoT).

Cleric.name: Veil
Cleric.originalText: Veil: Gain passive True Sight vs invisible or ethereal creatures.

Cleric.name: Echoes
Cleric.originalText: Echoes: 10% of healing or damage is repeated 1 turn later (Echo Effect).

Cleric.name: Divine Smite
Cleric.originalText: Divine Smite: Channel divine energy into a powerful strike against a single enemy, dealing damage based on your Wisdom and consuming 1 Conviction.

Cleric.name: Healing Rite
Cleric.originalText: Healing Rite: A channeled ability that restores health to an ally, with increased effectiveness on consecrated ground.

Cleric.name: Sacred Chant
Cleric.originalText: Sacred Chant: A sustained prayer that generates 1 Conviction every 3 turns while maintained.

Cleric.name: Consecrate
Cleric.originalText: Consecrate: Sanctify the ground in a 15-foot radius, creating consecrated terrain that enhances your healing abilities and weakens undead enemies.

Cleric.name: Divine Insight
Cleric.originalText: Divine Insight: Commune briefly with your deity to gain insight about a religious matter, sacred location, or divine presence.

Cleric.name: Aura of Faith
Cleric.originalText: Aura of Faith: Allies in range gain +5% healing received and +1 to saves.

Cleric.name: Sermon of Purpose
Cleric.originalText: Sermon of Purpose: Chants now generate 1 Conviction every 2 turns.

Cleric.name: Liturgical Flow
Cleric.originalText: Liturgical Flow: Chaining 2 Rites reduces cooldown of your next Invocation by 1 turn.

Cleric.name: Anointed Guardian
Cleric.originalText: Anointed Guardian: First time an ally drops below 20% HP per combat, grant them a 30% damage reduction shield for 2 rounds.

Cleric.name: Sanctified Reprisal
Cleric.originalText: Sanctified Reprisal: Whenever you heal, next Smite deals 20% more damage and stuns Undead.

Cleric.name: Miraculous Channel
Cleric.originalText: Miraculous Channel: Sacrificing 3 Conviction causes your next Rite to affect the full party.

Cleric.name: Bishop's Mandate
Cleric.originalText: Capstone: Bishop's Mandate: Activating a Sacrament automatically casts a free Invocation without cost or cooldown.

Cleric.name: Divine Invocation
Cleric.originalText: Divine Invocation: Channel a powerful prayer based on your chosen Invocation Path, with effects ranging from mass healing to divine fire or protective barriers.

Cleric.name: Sacrament
Cleric.originalText: Sacrament: Perform a sacred ceremony that consumes Conviction to create a powerful, sustained effect in an area.

Cleric.name: Banish Unholy
Cleric.originalText: Banish Unholy: Channel divine energy to damage and potentially banish undead, demons, or other unholy entities.

Cleric.name: Blessing of Protection
Cleric.originalText: Blessing of Protection:  Bestow a divine blessing on an ally, granting them resistance to a specific damage type or condition.

Cleric.name: Commune
Cleric.originalText: Commune:  Enter a deep meditative state to receive guidance directly from your deity, gaining insight on important matters or divine intervention.

Cleric.name: Aura of Grace
Cleric.originalText: Aura of Grace: Allies in range resist critical hits and gain minor HP regen.

Cleric.name: Divine Rebirth
Cleric.originalText: Divine Rebirth: On revive, ally returns with 50% HP and a temporary resistance shield.

Cleric.name: Merciful Sacrament
Cleric.originalText: Merciful Sacrament: Sacraments cost no Conviction if used on an ally under 25% HP.

Cleric.name: Unyielding Light
Cleric.originalText: Unyielding Light: Once per day, prevents party wipe and restores 30% HP.

Cleric.name: Celestial Resurgence
Cleric.originalText: Final Miracle: Celestial Resurgence: Revive all allies who died within the last 3 turns.

Cleric.name: Mass Healing Light
Cleric.originalText: Mass Healing Light: Channel divine energy to heal all allies within 30 feet, with increased effectiveness on those most wounded.

Cleric.name: Divine Intervention
Cleric.originalText: Divine Intervention: Call upon your deity to intervene directly, potentially averting disaster or creating a miraculous effect.

Cleric.name: Sanctify Being
Cleric.originalText: Sanctify Being: Bestow temporary divine protection on an ally, granting them immunity to specific conditions or damage types.

Cleric.name: Radiant Burst
Cleric.originalText: Radiant Burst: Release a powerful wave of divine energy that heals allies and damages unholy creatures.

Cleric.name: Resurrection
Cleric.originalText: Resurrection: Return a fallen ally to life with renewed vigor and temporary divine blessing.

Cleric.name: Scriptural Echo
Cleric.originalText: Scriptural Echo: Casting a Rite repeats the Invocation used previously for 50% effect.

Cleric.name: Words of Equilibrium
Cleric.originalText: Words of Equilibrium: Heal and Damage dealt scale off the higher of INT or WIS.

Cleric.name: Balanced Scales
Cleric.originalText: Balanced Scales: Enemies take divine damage if they attack healed targets.

Cleric.name: Doctrine Shield
Cleric.originalText: Doctrine Shield: Gain 1 Conviction anytime a condition is removed.

Cleric.name: Word of Binding
Cleric.originalText: Final Miracle: Word of Binding: Enemies in a large AoE are silenced, snared, and take +25% divine damage for 3 turns.

Cleric.name: Balance Restoration
Cleric.originalText: Balance Restoration: Channel divine energy that both heals allies and damages enemies in an area, maintaining cosmic balance.

Cleric.name: Divine Judgment
Cleric.originalText: Divine Judgment: Mark an enemy for judgment, causing them to take damage proportional to the harm they inflict.

Cleric.name: Ritual of Cleansing
Cleric.originalText: Ritual of Cleansing: Perform a ritual that removes multiple negative conditions from allies while potentially imposing them on enemies.

Cleric.name: Word of Power
Cleric.originalText: Word of Power: Speak a divine word that has different effects based on the target's nature and actions.

Cleric.name: Cosmic Equilibrium
Cleric.originalText: Cosmic Equilibrium: Create a zone where healing and harm are balanced, converting excess damage to healing and vice versa.

Cleric.name: Sanguine Rite
Cleric.originalText: Sanguine Rite:  Rites damage enemies and heal allies for a portion of the same amount.

Cleric.name: Blasphemous Tongue
Cleric.originalText: Blasphemous Tongue: Sacraments inflict Doomed, reducing healing received and buff duration.

Cleric.name: Dark Conviction
Cleric.originalText: Dark Conviction: Killing an enemy grants 1 Conviction instantly.

Cleric.name: Zealot's Touch
Cleric.originalText: Zealot's Touch: Healing over time effects become life drain if cast on enemies.

Cleric.name: Rite of the Crimson Choir
Cleric.originalText: Final Miracle: Rite of the Crimson Choir: Summon 4 fanatics for 3 turns. Each heals you for 10% of their damage dealt and explodes in death.

Cleric.name: Blood Sacrifice
Cleric.originalText: Blood Sacrifice: Sacrifice a portion of your health or an ally's to generate Conviction and empower your next divine ability.

Cleric.name: Dark Sacrament
Cleric.originalText: Dark Sacrament: Perform a twisted ritual that drains life from enemies to heal allies or create other beneficial effects.

Cleric.name: Corrupt Divinity
Cleric.originalText: Corrupt Divinity: Channel corrupted divine energy to weaken enemies and potentially convert them to your cause.

Cleric.name: Zealot's Fervor
Cleric.originalText: Zealot's Fervor: Enter a state of religious frenzy, increasing your damage output and healing power at the cost of defense.

Cleric.name: Ritual of Undeath
Cleric.originalText: Ritual of Undeath: Perform a forbidden ritual that can temporarily raise fallen enemies as servants or prevent allies from dying by transforming them into undead-like entities.

Crimson Agent.name: Arterial Cut
Crimson Agent.originalText: Arterial Cut: Critical hits apply Bleed for 3 turns; Bleed duration +2 turns.

Crimson Agent.name: Blood Tithe
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blood Tithe: Killing a bleeding target restores 10% of max HP.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinweaver's Core
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinweaver's Core: Unlocks use of Veinweaves (1 active at a time).

Crimson Agent.name: Vital Targeting
Crimson Agent.originalText: Vital Targeting: +15% damage to flanked or unaware enemies.

Crimson Agent.name: Shroudstep
Crimson Agent.originalText: Shroudstep: After using stealth movement, gain +10% dodge for 1 turn.

Crimson Agent.name: Hemorrhage Slash
Crimson Agent.originalText: Hemorrhage Slash: A precise strike that deals moderate damage and applies Bleed status to the target, generating 1 Blood Gauge point.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinweave: Quickblood
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinweave: Quickblood: Consume 1 Blood Gauge point to increase your movement and attack speed by 15% for 3 turns.

Crimson Agent.name: Blood Mark
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blood Mark: Apply a magical mark to a bleeding target that lasts for 5 turns. The mark can be detonated for additional effects.

Crimson Agent.name: Shroud
Crimson Agent.originalText: Shroud: Enter stealth mode, becoming invisible to enemies until you attack or move into bright light. Limited uses per encounter.

Crimson Agent.name: Vital Sense
Crimson Agent.originalText: Vital Sense: Heighten your senses for 1 minute, allowing you to detect the presence of living creatures within 60 feet and see their vital points more clearly (+10% critical hit chance).

Crimson Agent.name: Blood Echo
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blood Echo: Bleeds now stack twice and deal +10% more damage.

Crimson Agent.name: Bio-Alchemical Flow
Crimson Agent.originalText: Bio-Alchemical Flow: Veinweaves do not break stealth.

Crimson Agent.name: Spill Control
Crimson Agent.originalText: Spill Control: Max Blood Gauge increased to 6.

Crimson Agent.name: Rupture Trigger
Crimson Agent.originalText: Rupture Trigger: Detonating a Blood Mark causes AoE Bleed in a small radius.

Crimson Agent.name: Crimson Flow
Crimson Agent.originalText: Crimson Flow: Using Blood Gauge grants +10% movement and attack speed for 2 turns.

Crimson Agent.name: Crimson Harmony
Crimson Agent.originalText: Crimson Harmony: Maintain 2 Veinweaves simultaneously.

Crimson Agent.name: Bloodbound Edge
Crimson Agent.originalText: Capstone – Bloodbound Edge: Once per rest, convert all Bleeds on enemies to instant True Damage.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinweave: Bloodshield
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinweave: Bloodshield: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to create a protective barrier that absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health.

Crimson Agent.name: Rupture
Crimson Agent.originalText: Rupture: Detonate a Blood Mark on a target, dealing significant damage and consuming the mark.

Crimson Agent.name: Bloodtrail
Crimson Agent.originalText: Bloodtrail: Mark a bleeding target, allowing you to track them perfectly for 1 hour regardless of distance or obstacles.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinweave: Sensory Theft
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinweave: Sensory Theft: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to briefly experience what a bleeding target sees and hears.

Crimson Agent.name: Hemostasis
Crimson Agent.originalText: Hemostasis: Stop all bleeding effects on yourself or an ally, converting each remaining turn of Bleed into a small amount of healing.

Crimson Agent.name: Bloodbond
Crimson Agent.originalText: Bloodbond: Link with an ally; share 25% incoming damage and transfer 10% healing to them.

Crimson Agent.name: Hemostasis
Crimson Agent.originalText: Hemostasis: Bleeds applied to allies now heal them instead.

Crimson Agent.name: Protective Flow
Crimson Agent.originalText: Protective Flow: Allies affected by your Veinweaves gain 10% DR and +1 to all saves.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinlock Tether
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinlock Tether: Form a damage-sharing link with an ally for 3 turns.

Crimson Agent.name: Crimson Pact
Crimson Agent.originalText: Final Cut – Crimson Pact: Detonate all enemy Bleeds to heal nearby allies and grant them barriers. (1/day)

Crimson Agent.name: Transfusion
Crimson Agent.originalText: Transfusion: Transfer health from yourself to an ally, healing them for 150% of the health sacrificed.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinweave: Vitality Link
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinweave: Vitality Link: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to link with an ally, sharing beneficial effects and healing for 3 turns.

Crimson Agent.name: Blood Ward
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blood Ward: Create a protective circle using blood magic that shields allies within from certain types of damage or effects.

Crimson Agent.name: Purify Blood
Crimson Agent.originalText: Purify Blood: Remove poison, disease, or other blood-borne afflictions from a target.

Crimson Agent.name: Lifewell
Crimson Agent.originalText: Lifewell: Ultimate ability that converts all your remaining Blood Gauge into a powerful healing aura for allies.

Crimson Agent.name: Ghost Vein
Crimson Agent.originalText: Ghost Vein: Attacks from stealth ignore 25% of target resistances.

Crimson Agent.name: Blackout Agent
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blackout Agent: Dodging an attack blinds the attacker for 1 turn.

Crimson Agent.name: Ghostflow Reflexes
Crimson Agent.originalText: Ghostflow Reflexes: While Veinweave is active: +5% dodge, cooldowns -1, +10% crit resistance.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinjammer
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinjammer: Bleeds reduce enemy casting and action speed by 10%.

Crimson Agent.name: Total Silence
Crimson Agent.originalText: Final Cut – Total Silence: AoE disables all enemy passives and silences for 2 turns.

Crimson Agent.name: Phantom Strike
Crimson Agent.originalText: Phantom Strike: Attack from stealth with increased critical chance and apply a Blood Mark automatically.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinweave: Shadow Meld
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinweave: Shadow Meld: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to become nearly undetectable for 1 minute, gaining enhanced stealth capabilities.

Crimson Agent.name: Disrupt Flow
Crimson Agent.originalText: Disrupt Flow: Temporarily disable a target's special abilities by disrupting their vital energies.

Crimson Agent.name: Blood Cipher
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blood Cipher: Extract information directly from a bleeding target's blood, potentially learning secrets or weaknesses.

Crimson Agent.name: Blackout
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blackout: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of magical darkness where only you can see clearly, granting significant advantages.

Crimson Agent.name: Blood Frenzy
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blood Frenzy: +5% damage per enemy actively bleeding (max +25%).

Crimson Agent.name: Hemorrhagic Plague
Crimson Agent.originalText: Hemorrhagic Plague: Bleeds automatically spread to nearby enemies every 3 turns.

Crimson Agent.name: Pain-to-Power Conduction
Crimson Agent.originalText: Pain-to-Power Conduction: Veinweaves explode when struck, dealing AoE Bleed and minor Fear.

Crimson Agent.name: Carrion Conductor
Crimson Agent.originalText: Carrion Conductor: Corpses leave behind blood pools that explode for AoE damage.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinburst Requiem
Crimson Agent.originalText: Final Cut – Veinburst Requiem: Detonates all Bleeds and Blood Gauge effects in range. Enemies under 25% HP are instantly executed. (1/day)

Crimson Agent.name: Exsanguinate
Crimson Agent.originalText: Exsanguinate: Violently extract blood from a target, dealing heavy damage to bleeding enemies and generating additional Blood Gauge.

Crimson Agent.name: Veinweave: Blood Frenzy
Crimson Agent.originalText: Veinweave: Blood Frenzy: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to enter a frenzied state, increasing damage and attack speed but reducing defense.

Crimson Agent.name: Blood Boil
Crimson Agent.originalText: Blood Boil: Cause a target's blood to heat rapidly, dealing internal damage and potentially stunning them.

Crimson Agent.name: Crimson Harvest
Crimson Agent.originalText: Crimson Harvest: Execute a heavily wounded target, restoring health and Blood Gauge based on the target's missing health.

Crimson Agent.name: Bloodstorm
Crimson Agent.originalText: Bloodstorm: Ultimate ability that creates a swirling vortex of blood, dealing continuous damage to enemies and empowering your abilities.

Dragoon.name: Skybound Assault
Dragoon.originalText: Skybound Assault: Leap to a target and deal +25% damage. Grants 1 Momentum.

Dragoon.name: Draconic Discipline
Dragoon.originalText: Draconic Discipline: Gain +10% resistance to knockback and crowd control.

Dragoon.name: Momentum Engine
Dragoon.originalText: Momentum Engine: Movement of 3+ tiles in a turn grants 1 Momentum (Max 5).

Dragoon.name: Dragoon's Reach
Dragoon.originalText: Dragoon's Reach: Polearm attacks strike 1 tile further and have +5% crit chance.

Dragoon.name: Aerial Poise
Dragoon.originalText: Aerial Poise: While airborne, take 25% reduced damage from ranged attacks.

Dragoon.name: Dragon Leap
Dragoon.originalText: Dragon Leap: Launch yourself into the air and come crashing down on a target up to 30 feet away, dealing damage based on your Strength and height.

Dragoon.name: Piercing Thrust
Dragoon.originalText: Piercing Thrust: A powerful spear attack that partially ignores enemy armor and has increased critical hit chance.

Dragoon.name: Wyvern's Guard
Dragoon.originalText: Wyvern's Guard: Enter a defensive stance that increases your resistance to damage from the next attack.

Dragoon.name: Momentum Surge
Dragoon.originalText: Momentum Surge: Consume 2 Momentum to gain a burst of speed and +1 to your next attack roll.

Dragoon.name: Draconic Roar
Dragoon.originalText: Draconic Roar: Release a intimidating battle cry that can frighten weaker enemies and rally allies.

Dragoon.name: Crater Strike
Dragoon.originalText: Crater Strike: Leap attack that applies knockdown in a small AoE.

Dragoon.name: Momentum Overflow
Dragoon.originalText: Momentum Overflow: Exceed Momentum cap (Max 7), bonus damage scales with overflow.

Dragoon.name: Piercing Howl
Dragoon.originalText: Piercing Howl: Next polearm strike ignores 50% armor.

Dragoon.name: Lance Tempo
Dragoon.originalText: Lance Tempo: If you moved this turn, gain +10% evasion and +10% crit damage.

Dragoon.name: Wyvern's Flow
Dragoon.originalText: Wyvern's Flow: Successful leaps refund 1 Momentum and reduce next cooldown by 1.

Dragoon.name: Apex Assault
Dragoon.originalText: Apex Assault: Ultimate leap: high damage finisher that consumes all Momentum.

Dragoon.name: Lancer's Apex
Dragoon.originalText: Capstone – Lancer's Apex: Leap attacks now cost no action if performed at max Momentum (1/encounter).

Dragoon.name: Dragonflight
Dragoon.originalText: Dragonflight: An enhanced leap ability that allows you to jump twice as high and far, with increased damage based on distance traveled.

Dragoon.name: Spear Cyclone
Dragoon.originalText: Spear Cyclone: Spin your polearm in a wide arc, striking all enemies within range and building Momentum for each hit.

Dragoon.name: Momentum Burst
Dragoon.originalText: Momentum Burst: Consume all Momentum to gain a significant boost to your next attack's damage and critical hit chance.

Dragoon.name: Aerial Recovery
Dragoon.originalText: Aerial Recovery: After being knocked down or back, instantly regain your footing and gain 1 Momentum.

Dragoon.name: Dragon's Eye
Dragoon.originalText: Dragon's Eye: Briefly gain the keen vision of a dragon, allowing you to spot weaknesses in enemy defenses and increase your critical hit range.

Dragoon.name: Aegis Leap
Dragoon.originalText: Aegis Leap: Leap to an ally and intercept the next attack made against them.

Dragoon.name: Wyrmhide
Dragoon.originalText: Wyrmhide: Gain +10% DR and immunity to Bleed/Burn/Poison while above 50% HP.

Dragoon.name: Momentum Shield
Dragoon.originalText: Momentum Shield: Spending Momentum grants temporary HP.

Dragoon.name: Spiral Defense
Dragoon.originalText: Spiral Defense: Automatically counter melee attacks with a polearm when at max Momentum.

Dragoon.name: Bastion Descent
Dragoon.originalText: Final Flight – Bastion Descent: Slam down between allies, cleansing effects and shielding the group.

Dragoon.name: Guardian's Intercept
Dragoon.originalText: Guardian's Intercept: Leap to an ally's position and take the next attack targeted at them, with reduced damage to yourself.

Dragoon.name: Draconic Ward
Dragoon.originalText: Draconic Ward: Channel draconic energy to create a protective aura around yourself and nearby allies, reducing incoming damage.

Dragoon.name: Wyrmscale Defense
Dragoon.originalText: Wyrmscale Defense: Temporarily harden your skin like dragon scales, gaining significant damage reduction and status effect resistance.

Dragoon.name: Momentum Barrier
Dragoon.originalText: Momentum Barrier: Convert your Momentum into a protective shield that absorbs damage for you and nearby allies.

Dragoon.name: Dragon's Sanctuary
Dragoon.originalText: Dragon's Sanctuary: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of protection, significantly reducing damage to all allies within range and cleansing negative effects.

Dragoon.name: Drake Mark
Dragoon.originalText: Drake Mark: Each leap attack marks enemies. Marked enemies take +10% damage from you.

Dragoon.name: Elemental Spearcraft
Dragoon.originalText: Elemental Spearcraft: Infuse polearms with Fire, Ice, or Lightning for 3 turns (switchable).

Dragoon.name: Air Mastery

Ranger.name: Hunter's Reflex

Ranger.name: Shadow Step
Ranger.originalText: Shadow Step: Leave no tracks and make no sound when moving at normal speed.

Ranger.name: Keen Hunter
Ranger.originalText: Keen Hunter: Tracked targets cannot hide from you within your line of sight.

Ranger.name: Efficient Killer
Ranger.originalText: Efficient Killer: Reduce the Hit Chain requirement for Druidic Arrow to 2 hits instead of 3.

Ranger.name: Camouflage Step
Ranger.originalText: Camouflage Step: Become invisible until you make your first attack.

Ranger.name: Silent Volley
Ranger.originalText: Silent Volley: Fire three arrows in rapid succession, ignoring armor bonuses.

Ranger.name: Shattershot
Ranger.originalText: Shattershot: Fire a specialized arrow that breaks shields and removes magical buffs.

Ranger.name: Ghost Strike
Ranger.originalText: Ghost Strike: Make a melee attack that bypasses physical armor.

Ranger.name: Vanishing Act
Ranger.originalText: Vanishing Act: Disappear from sight and reposition to any point within 30 feet.

Ranger.name: Predator's Grin
Ranger.originalText: Predator's Grin: Killing a tracked target grants you an extra action once per rest.

Ranger.name: Toxic Affinity
Ranger.originalText: Toxic Affinity: Gain immunity to poison and disease.

Ranger.name: Corruption Touch
Ranger.originalText: Corruption Touch: Your elemental imbues last twice as long and spread to adjacent targets on critical hits.

Ranger.name: Blight Infusion
Ranger.originalText: Blight Infusion: Your Druidic Arrows inflict Blight on hit if the terrain is corrupted.

Ranger.name: Venom Rain
Ranger.originalText: Venom Rain: Create an area effect that deals poison damage and applies Corruption.

Ranger.name: Rotting Tether
Ranger.originalText: Rotting Tether: Link an enemy to corrupted terrain, causing damage when they move.

Ranger.name: Entropic March
Ranger.originalText: Entropic March: Convert natural terrain into Blighted terrain in a large area.

Ranger.name: Withering Shot
Ranger.originalText: Withering Shot: Fire an arrow that drastically reduces the target's healing received.

Ranger.name: Plague Bearer
Ranger.originalText: Plague Bearer: Infect yourself with a controlled disease that spreads to enemies you damage.

Shaman.name: Elemental Affinity
Shaman.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Choose an element (Fire, Ice, Air, or Earth) that enhances your abilities.

Shaman.name: Spirit Sight
Shaman.originalText: Spirit Sight: Perceive spirits and elemental forces invisible to others.

Shaman.name: Alchemical Knowledge
Shaman.originalText: Alchemical Knowledge: Identify potions and alchemical substances with greater accuracy.

Shaman.name: Primal Resilience
Shaman.originalText: Primal Resilience: Gain resistance to your chosen elemental affinity.

Shaman.name: Ancestral Whispers
Shaman.originalText: Ancestral Whispers: Occasionally receive guidance from ancestral spirits when in danger.

Shaman.name: Flask Use

Shaman.name: Totem Casting
Shaman.originalText: Totem Casting: Place a totem that creates an aura effect for 3 rounds.

Shaman.name: Spirit Shock
Shaman.originalText: Spirit Shock: Channel elemental energy into a damaging burst.

Shaman.name: Commune with Spirits
Shaman.originalText: Commune with Spirits: Gain information about an area or object by consulting with local spirits.

Shaman.name: Elemental Ward
Shaman.originalText: Elemental Ward: Create a temporary barrier against a specific type of elemental damage.

Shaman.name: Enhanced Elemental Attunement
Shaman.originalText: Enhanced Elemental Attunement: Your chosen element grants additional benefits to your abilities.

Shaman.name: Extended Totem Duration
Shaman.originalText: Extended Totem Duration: Totems last for an additional round.

Shaman.name: Spirit Cache
Shaman.originalText: Spirit Cache: Store one flask or totem effect to recast later (once per encounter).

Shaman.name: Totem Pulse
Shaman.originalText: Totem Pulse: Totems create an immediate area effect when placed (level 6).

Shaman.name: Spirit Saturation
Shaman.originalText: Spirit Saturation: Gain one free totem cast per combat (level 9).

Shaman.name: Elemental Channeling
Shaman.originalText: Elemental Channeling: Temporarily embody your chosen element, gaining related benefits.

Shaman.name: Spirit Walk
Shaman.originalText: Spirit Walk: Briefly become incorporeal, passing through solid objects or avoiding damage.

Shaman.name: Ancestral Guardian
Shaman.originalText: Ancestral Guardian: Summon a protective spirit that intercepts damage meant for you.

Shaman.name: Elemental Surge
Shaman.originalText: Elemental Surge: Enhance a totem's effect for one round.

Shaman.name: Spirit Binding
Shaman.originalText: Spirit Binding: Temporarily bind a minor elemental spirit to an object or ally, granting benefits.

Shaman.name: Echo Totem
Shaman.originalText: Echo Totem: Automatically cast a second, weaker totem when placing your primary totem.

Shaman.name: Elemental Harmony
Shaman.originalText: Elemental Harmony: Your elemental summons gain increased duration and health.

Shaman.name: Spiritual Resonance
Shaman.originalText: Spiritual Resonance: Totems affect a larger area when placed near each other.

Shaman.name: Benevolent Spirits
Shaman.originalText: Benevolent Spirits: Your healing effects are 25% more powerful on allies below half health.

Shaman.name: Summon Ice Wisp
Shaman.originalText: Summon Ice Wisp: Call forth a spirit of frost that can snare and freeze enemies.

Shaman.name: Summon Airling
Shaman.originalText: Summon Airling: Conjure an air elemental that stuns enemies and deals lightning damage.

Shaman.name: Summon Cinderflame
Shaman.originalText: Summon Cinderflame: Create a fire spirit that applies burning damage over time and explodes on death.

Shaman.name: Summon Stonekin
Shaman.originalText: Summon Stonekin: Manifest an earth elemental that can root enemies and grant damage reduction to allies.

Shaman.name: Elemental Chorus
Shaman.originalText: Elemental Chorus: Ultimate ability that summons all four elemental types around a zone for massive combined effect.

Shaman.name: Divining Totem
Shaman.originalText: Divining Totem: Place a special totem that reveals enemy actions before they occur (one target per round).

Shaman.name: Predictive Alchemy
Shaman.originalText: Predictive Alchemy: Your flasks have a chance to not be consumed when used.

Shaman.name: Fate's Whisper
Shaman.originalText: Fate's Whisper: Gain advantage on one saving throw per encounter.

Shaman.name: Balanced Elements
Shaman.originalText: Balanced Elements: Your elemental effects last longer and have secondary effects.

Shaman.name: Delayed Detonation
Shaman.originalText: Delayed Detonation: Throw a flask that explodes after a set time or trigger.

Shaman.name: Healing Splash
Shaman.originalText: Healing Splash: Convert a damage flask into an area healing effect.

Shaman.name: Omen Brand
Shaman.originalText: Omen Brand: Mark a target so that the next ally's ability against them automatically hits.

Shaman.name: Fate Weaving
Shaman.originalText: Fate Weaving: Manipulate probability to force a reroll of any die.

Shaman.name: Omen Loop
Shaman.originalText: Omen Loop: Ultimate ability that repeats a spell, flask, or totem cast from two turns ago (once per encounter).

Shaman.name: Hagraven Form
Shaman.originalText: Hagraven Form: Your body transforms into a twisted, avian-humanoid hybrid with natural weapons and resistances.

Shaman.name: Blood Feast
Shaman.originalText: Blood Feast: Heal when enemies near you are bleeding.

Shaman.name: Necrotic Aura
Shaman.originalText: Necrotic Aura: Enemies within 10 feet take minor necrotic damage each round.

Shaman.name: Spell Resistance
Shaman.originalText: Spell Resistance: Gain advantage on saves against spells and magical effects.

Shaman.name: Blight Totem
Shaman.originalText: Blight Totem: Place a corrupted totem that reduces all healing in its area by 50%.

Shaman.name: Blood Curse
Shaman.originalText: Blood Curse: Inflict a bleeding wound that cannot be healed normally.

Shaman.name: Talon Strike
Shaman.originalText: Talon Strike: Make a vicious attack that causes bleeding and reduces healing received.

Shaman.name: Death Shriek
Shaman.originalText: Death Shriek: Emit a terrifying cry that causes enemies to have disadvantage on concentration and casting.

Shaman.name: Bloodroot Trail
Shaman.originalText: Bloodroot Trail: Ultimate ability that leaves a cursed line wherever you move; enemies crossing it take damage and start bleeding.

Soldier.name: Overwatch
Soldier.originalText: Overwatch: Set up a reaction shot against movement in your designated zone.

Soldier.name: Shield Trained

Soldier.name: Tactical Awareness

Soldier.name: Defensive Positioning

Soldier.name: Steady Aim

Soldier.name: Covering Fire

Soldier.name: Quick Deploy
Soldier.originalText: Quick Deploy: Set up a temporary barricade that provides partial cover.

Soldier.name: Warning Shot
Soldier.originalText: Warning Shot: Fire a deterrent shot that imposes disadvantage on an enemy's next attack.

Soldier.name: Tactical Reposition
Soldier.originalText: Tactical Reposition: Move half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

Soldier.name: Rally Point
Soldier.originalText: Rally Point: Designate a location that grants allies who move there a small defensive bonus.

Soldier.name: Command Step
Soldier.originalText: Command Step: Once per round, shift one adjacent ally 1 tile in any direction.

Soldier.name: Formation Lock
Soldier.originalText: Formation Lock: Allies adjacent to you cannot be flanked.

Soldier.name: Iron Orders
Soldier.originalText: Iron Orders: All allies within 3 tiles gain +1 Save vs Fear and +1 AC.

Soldier.name: Palisade Deployment
Soldier.originalText: Palisade Deployment: Deploy a 2x1 barrier that blocks movement and line of sight (level 5).

Soldier.name: Intercepting Shot
Soldier.originalText: Intercepting Shot: Use your reaction to fire at an enemy about to hit an ally within 5 tiles (level 6).

Soldier.originalText: Fortify Zone: Enemies in a 3x3 area take –2 to ranged attacks against your allies (level 9).

Soldier.name: Tactical Assessment
Soldier.originalText: Tactical Assessment: Analyze the battlefield to gain information about enemy weaknesses.

Soldier.name: Coordinated Maneuver
Soldier.originalText: Coordinated Maneuver: Direct an ally to move and take an action out of turn.

Soldier.name: Suppression Fire

Soldier.name: Defensive Formation
Soldier.originalText: Defensive Formation: Arrange allies in an optimal pattern, granting defensive bonuses.

Soldier.name: Hold the Line

Soldier.name: Protective Aura
Soldier.originalText: Protective Aura: Nearby allies ignore fear and charm effects while you stand.

Soldier.name: Selfless Guardian
Soldier.originalText: Selfless Guardian: Take reduced damage when intercepting attacks meant for allies.

Soldier.name: Inspiring Presence
Soldier.originalText: Inspiring Presence: Allies within sight gain a bonus to morale saves.

Soldier.name: Defensive Expertise
Soldier.originalText: Defensive Expertise: Gain additional damage reduction when using defensive abilities.

Soldier.name: Guardian's Rush
Soldier.originalText: Guardian's Rush: Move adjacent to an ally being attacked, potentially intercepting the blow.

Soldier.name: Divine Lockdown
Soldier.originalText: Divine Lockdown: Prevent enemy movement in a small area (once per encounter).

Soldier.name: Wall of Aegis
Soldier.originalText: Wall of Aegis: Grant all adjacent allies +2 Damage Reduction for 2 rounds.

Soldier.name: Rallying Cry
Soldier.originalText: Rallying Cry: Remove fear effects from nearby allies and grant temporary hit points.

Soldier.name: Sacrificial Defense
Soldier.originalText: Sacrificial Defense: Take damage in place of an ally, converting a portion to non-lethal damage.

Soldier.name: Enhanced Overwatch
Soldier.originalText: Enhanced Overwatch: Your Overwatch can reveal and fire on stealthed or invisible enemies.

Soldier.name: Tactical Reload

Soldier.name: Palisade Synergy
Soldier.originalText: Palisade Synergy: Your attacks deal additional damage to enemies adjacent to your palisades.

Soldier.name: Precision Engineering
Soldier.originalText: Precision Engineering: Your deployed structures have increased durability and effectiveness.

Soldier.name: Net Bolt
Soldier.originalText: Net Bolt: Fire a specialized bolt that snares the target on hit (no save).

Soldier.name: Shatterburst
Soldier.originalText: Shatterburst: Fire a cone volley that imposes a -1 attack penalty on enemies for 1 round.

Soldier.name: Repel Shot
Soldier.originalText: Repel Shot: Use your reaction to knock back a melee attacker (2 charges).

Soldier.name: Turret Deployment
Soldier.originalText: Turret Deployment: Deploy up to 2 automated turrets that last 3 rounds, firing for 1d6+WIS damage and applying Snare or Disrupt effects.

Soldier.name: Bubble of Discipline
Soldier.originalText: Bubble of Discipline: Create a 3x3 area effect that blocks 1 spell per ally for 2 rounds (once per rest).

Soldier.name: Intimidating Presence
Soldier.originalText: Intimidating Presence: Enemies that can see you have disadvantage on morale checks.

Soldier.name: Cruel Efficiency
Soldier.originalText: Cruel Efficiency: Gain a stacking damage bonus when hitting the same target consecutively.

Soldier.name: Marked for Death
Soldier.originalText: Marked for Death: Enemies you designate take –1 to saves and deal –1 damage vs allies other than you.

Soldier.name: Ruthless Tactician
Soldier.originalText: Ruthless Tactician: Gain advantage on attacks against enemies that are flanked or hindered by terrain.

Soldier.name: Crushing Decree
Soldier.originalText: Crushing Decree: Taunt enemies in range, forcing them to target you.

Soldier.name: Impale Line
Soldier.originalText: Impale Line: Fire a shot that travels in a 4-tile line; if it hits 2+ targets, all enemies lose their reactions.

Soldier.name: Execution Zone
Soldier.originalText: Execution Zone: Create an area where enemies take –1 to morale and cannot escape.

Soldier.name: Demoralizing Shot
Soldier.originalText: Demoralizing Shot: Hit an enemy leader to impose disadvantage on all nearby enemy attacks.

Soldier.name: Brutal Example
Soldier.originalText: Brutal Example: Deal massive damage to a weakened target, causing nearby enemies to become frightened.

Thief.name: Sneak Attack
Thief.originalText: Sneak Attack: Deal 1d6 extra damage when attacking from stealth, against flanked targets, or targets suffering from Bleed, Poison, or Disable.

Thief.name: Lockpick Mastery
Thief.originalText: Lockpick Mastery: Gain +5 to open non-magical locks.

Thief.name: Stealth Chain
Thief.originalText: Stealth Chain: Gain +2 to your next stealth check after landing a Sneak Attack.

Thief.name: Toxin Sense
Thief.originalText: Toxin Sense: Identify resistances, immunities, or ideal poisons against enemies.

Thief.name: Trap Intuition
Thief.originalText: Trap Intuition: Gain advantage on checks to spot hidden traps and mechanisms.

Thief.name: Apply Poison
Thief.originalText: Apply Poison: Use a bonus action to apply poison to your weapon, lasting for 2 attacks.

Thief.name: Cunning Movement
Thief.originalText: Cunning Movement: Move through hostile-occupied tiles without provoking opportunity attacks.

Thief.name: Disable Device
Thief.originalText: Disable Device: Disarm non-magical traps, pressure plates, or poison glyphs.

Thief.name: Feint

Thief.name: Shadow Step

Thief.name: Combat Opener

Thief.name: Ambush Focus
Thief.originalText: Ambush Focus: Deal +2 damage against unaware or distracted targets.

Thief.name: Evasion

Thief.name: Trap Sense
Thief.originalText: Trap Sense: Gain passive trap detection and disarm bonuses (level 6).

Thief.name: Shadow Stab

Thief.name: Precision Feint

Thief.name: Analyze Weakness
Thief.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities and gain advantage on your next attack.

Thief.name: Distraction Tactics

Thief.name: Mage Sense

Thief.name: Arcane Resistance

Thief.name: Illusory Stealth

Thief.originalText: Ambusher's Grace: After killing a target or critically hitting one affected by Bleed or Poison, become untargetable until your next turn.

Thief.name: Persistent Bleed

Thief.name: Shadow Affinity

Thief.name: Smoke Bomb

Thief.name: Death Blossom
Thief.originalText: Death Blossom: Strike all adjacent enemies, applying Sneak Attack damage to one of them (level 17).

Thief.name: Exsanguinate
Thief.originalText: Exsanguinate: Gain 1 HP per round for each bleeding target within 3 tiles.

Thief.originalText: Prolonged Suffering: Bleeds you cause last twice as long.

Thief.originalText: Venom Master: On critical hits, your poisons also apply -1 to all saves.

Thief.name: Exotic Toxins

Tinker.name: Quick Fingers

Tinker.name: Tinker Bomb I

Tinker.name: Analyze Weakness
Tinker.originalText: Analyze Weakness: Study a target to identify vulnerabilities to specific damage types.

Tinker.name: Pet Upgrade Slot

Warrior.name: Mutation Adaptation

Warrior.originalText: Brutality Sense: You can sense when an opponent is below 25% health, marking them as vulnerable.

Warrior.name: Serum Injection
Warrior.originalText: Serum Injection: Activate a prepared mutation serum as a bonus action, triggering its effects for 3 rounds.

Warrior.name: Brutal Strike
Warrior.originalText: Brutal Strike: A powerful attack that deals additional damage based on your Strength and has a chance to stagger the target.

Warrior.name: Mutation Surge
Warrior.originalText: Mutation Surge: Temporarily enhance an active mutation, increasing its effects for 1 round but adding strain to your body.

Warrior.name: Intimidating Presence
Warrior.originalText: Intimidating Presence: Use your mutated appearance to frighten enemies, potentially causing them to flee or surrender.

Warrior.name: Survival Instinct
Warrior.originalText: Survival Instinct: Enter a heightened state of awareness, gaining bonuses to perception and reaction time for a short duration.

Warrior.name: Mutation Efficiency
Warrior.originalText: Mutation Efficiency: May have 2 active mutations at once (Lv 3)

Warrior.name: Brutal Fortitude
Warrior.originalText: Brutal Fortitude: Gain +1 DR for each BT stack (max +3)

Warrior.name: Overpressure Response
Warrior.originalText: Overpressure Response: Once per round, when struck by a critical hit, gain 1 free mutation activation

Warrior.name: Crushing Advance
Warrior.originalText: Crushing Advance: Once per long rest, move in a straight line up to 20 ft, knocking aside all enemies (STR save or fall prone, take 2d6)

Warrior.name: Pain Conversion
Warrior.originalText: Pain Conversion: Convert 10% of damage taken into temporary Strength bonus.

Warrior.name: Adaptive Tissue
Warrior.originalText: Adaptive Tissue: Gain resistance to the last damage type that critically hit you until your next rest.

Warrior.name: Brutality Momentum
Warrior.originalText: Brutality Momentum: Killing a marked vulnerable target instantly readies your next Brutal Strike.

Warrior.name: Mutation Overload
Warrior.originalText: Mutation Overload: Push your mutations beyond safe limits, gaining significantly enhanced effects for 2 rounds followed by exhaustion.

Warrior.name: Serum Cocktail
Warrior.originalText: Serum Cocktail: Combine two different serums for a hybrid effect, though with increased strain on your body.

Warrior.name: Brutality Unleashed
Warrior.originalText: Brutality Unleashed: Once your Brutality Threshold is crossed, unleash a devastating area attack that damages all enemies within range.

Warrior.name: Survival Adaptation
Warrior.originalText: Survival Adaptation: Rapidly adapt your body to environmental hazards, gaining temporary resistance to environmental effects.

Warrior.name: Intimidating Transformation
Warrior.originalText: Intimidating Transformation: Undergo a particularly terrifying mutation that can cause enemies to become frightened or even paralyzed with fear.

Warrior.name: Guardian Tissue
Warrior.originalText: Guardian Tissue: When an adjacent ally would take damage, you can absorb 30% of it as a reaction.

Warrior.name: Protective Mutations
Warrior.originalText: Protective Mutations: Your mutations generate a 5-foot aura that grants allies +10% damage resistance.

Warrior.name: Serum Sharing
Warrior.originalText: Serum Sharing: You can safely inject allies with diluted versions of your serums, granting them 50% of the benefits.

Warrior.name: Controlled Transformation
Warrior.originalText: Controlled Transformation: Your mutations appear less monstrous and can be partially concealed when necessary.

Warrior.name: Aegis Incarnate
Warrior.originalText: Final Form – Aegis Incarnate: Transform into a living shield for 3 rounds, becoming immovable and redirecting 50% of all damage dealt to allies within 15 feet to yourself.

Warrior.name: Bulwark Mutation Tree
Warrior.originalText: Bulwark Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

Warrior.name: Mutated Guard
Warrior.originalText: Mutated Guard: If you end your turn within 2 tiles of an ally, grant them +1 Save and DR

Warrior.name: Guardian Pulse
Warrior.originalText: Guardian Pulse: 1/rest, redirect an attack from an adjacent ally to yourself and immediately counterstrike

Warrior.name: Warding Mutation
Warrior.originalText: Warding Mutation: Develop protective growths that can absorb damage directed at allies.

Warrior.name: Stabilizing Injection
Warrior.originalText: Stabilizing Injection: Use your serum knowledge to create a stabilizing agent that can heal and remove negative status effects.

Warrior.name: Environmental Adaptation
Warrior.originalText: Environmental Adaptation: Your body automatically begins adapting to extreme environments after 1 minute of exposure.

Warrior.name: Regenerative Mutation
Warrior.originalText: Regenerative Mutation: Heal 5% of your maximum health each round while at least one mutation is active.

Warrior.name: Serum Recycling
Warrior.originalText: Serum Recycling: 20% chance to not consume a serum when activating a mutation.

Warrior.name: Damage Memory
Warrior.originalText: Damage Memory: After taking a specific damage type, gain increasing resistance to it with each subsequent hit.

Warrior.name: Adaptive Perfection
Warrior.originalText: Final Form – Adaptive Perfection: For 3 rounds, gain immunity to the damage types and environmental effects you've been exposed to during the current day.

Warrior.name: Gore Mutation Tree
Warrior.originalText: Gore Mutation Tree: Unlocks mutations like:

Warrior.name: Stack Overflow
Warrior.originalText: Stack Overflow: Can hold up to 4 BT stacks instead of 3

Warrior.name: Auto-Rupture
Warrior.originalText: Auto-Rupture: If you reach max BT, release a shockwave: all adjacent enemies must STR save or fall prone

Warrior.name: Adaptive Mutation
Warrior.originalText: Adaptive Mutation: Rapidly evolve your body to counter a specific threat or environmental hazard.

Warrior.name: Cellular Reconstruction
Warrior.originalText: Cellular Reconstruction: Enter a brief stasis where your body rapidly heals and purges toxins or diseases.

Warrior.name: Horrific Appearance
Warrior.originalText: Horrific Appearance: Enemies who see you activate a mutation must make a fear save or be frightened for 1 round.

Warrior.name: Infectious Mutation
Warrior.originalText: Infectious Mutation: Your attacks have a 10% chance to cause minor, painful mutations in your targets.

Warrior.name: Serum Toxicity
Warrior.originalText: Serum Toxicity: Your serums become poisonous to others; your blood deals acid damage to those who wound you.

Warrior.name: Pain Empowerment
Warrior.originalText: Pain Empowerment: Gain +5% damage for each 10% of health you are missing.

Warrior.name: Abomination Ascendant
Warrior.originalText: Final Form – Abomination Ascendant: Transform into a nightmarish creature for 3 rounds, gaining terrifying new attacks and abilities while causing fear in a 30-foot radius.

Warrior.name: Aberrant Mutation Tree
Warrior.originalText: Aberrant Mutation Tree: Unlocks:

Warrior.name: Terror Radius
Warrior.originalText: Terror Radius: Enemies within 3 tiles at start of turn must save or suffer –1 morale and –1 AC

Warrior.name: Apex Aberration (1/day)
Warrior.originalText: Apex Aberration (1/day): You transform for 2 rounds:

Warrior.name: Horrific Mutation
Warrior.originalText: Horrific Mutation: Undergo a particularly disturbing transformation designed to terrify and demoralize enemies.

Warrior.name: Toxic Secretion
Warrior.originalText: Toxic Secretion: Develop glands that secrete powerful toxins, allowing you to poison enemies with your attacks.

Wizard.name: Arcane Recovery
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Recovery: Once per day during a short rest, recover RP equal to half your Wizard level (rounded up), up to your normal maximum.

Wizard.name: Spell Scribing
Wizard.originalText: Spell Scribing: Copy spells into your spellbook at half the normal cost and time.

Wizard.name: Arcane Insight
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Insight: Identify magical effects and items with greater accuracy than non-wizards.

Wizard.name: Matrix Efficiency
Wizard.originalText: Matrix Efficiency: Reduce the preparation time for spells by 25%.

Wizard.name: Scholarly Mind
Wizard.originalText: Scholarly Mind: Gain advantage on Intelligence checks related to arcane knowledge.

Wizard.name: Arcane Bolt
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Bolt: Launch a bolt of pure arcane energy that deals force damage to a single target.

Wizard.name: Minor Conjuration
Wizard.originalText: Minor Conjuration: Create a temporary, small inanimate object that lasts for 1 hour.

Wizard.name: Arcane Shield
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Shield: Create a barrier of magical force that provides temporary protection.

Wizard.name: Analyze Magic
Wizard.originalText: Analyze Magic: Study a magical effect or item to gain insight into its properties and function.

Wizard.name: Spellbook Study
Wizard.originalText: Spellbook Study: Spend time studying your spellbook to prepare a different selection of spells.

Wizard.name: Floating Preparation
Wizard.originalText: Floating Preparation: Prepare 1 extra spell from any school each day

Wizard.name: Sigil Rewrite
Wizard.originalText: Sigil Rewrite: Once/day, instantly swap a spell you know for another of the same tier

Wizard.name: Spell Tether
Wizard.originalText: Spell Tether: Maintain 2 self-buff spells without concentration (1/rest)

Wizard.name: Matrix Mastery
Wizard.originalText: Matrix Mastery: Modify spell matrices to change minor aspects of prepared spells.

Wizard.name: Arcane Tradition
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Tradition: Choose a school of magic to specialize in, gaining bonuses to spells of that school.

Wizard.name: Spell Efficiency
Wizard.originalText: Spell Efficiency: Reduce the Resonance Point cost of frequently cast spells by 10%.

Wizard.name: Improved Concentration
Wizard.originalText: Improved Concentration: Advantage on concentration checks when taking damage.

Wizard.name: Counterspell
Wizard.originalText: Counterspell: Disrupt an enemy's spellcasting, potentially negating their spell entirely.

Wizard.name: Arcane Lock
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Lock: Create a magical barrier that prevents entry or access to an object or area.

Wizard.name: Dispel Magic
Wizard.originalText: Dispel Magic: End magical effects in an area or on a target.

Wizard.name: Dimensional Pocket
Wizard.originalText: Dimensional Pocket: Create a small extradimensional space to store items.

Wizard.name: Arcane Sight
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Sight: See magical auras and effects for a short duration.

Wizard.name: Sigil Authority
Wizard.originalText: Sigil Authority: +1 to all counterspell rolls, +2 DC vs targets currently affected by crowd control

Wizard.name: Spell Preservation
Wizard.originalText: Spell Preservation: Your spellbook cannot be destroyed by non-artifact means.

Wizard.name: Knowledge Shield
Wizard.originalText: Knowledge Shield: When you cast a protective spell, allies gain +2 to saving throws.

Wizard.name: Matrix Sharing
Wizard.originalText: Matrix Sharing: Grant an ally temporary access to one of your prepared spells.

Wizard.name: Arcane Memory
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Memory: Recall and cast any spell you've ever prepared once per long rest.

Wizard.name: Seal Magic
Wizard.originalText: Seal Magic: Prevent a target from casting spells of a specific school (WIS save, 3 rounds)

Wizard.name: Runic Snare
Wizard.originalText: Runic Snare: Glyph trap explodes in a 2x2 root + disarm on trigger

Wizard.name: Counterpulse
Wizard.originalText: Counterpulse: Countering a spell silences the caster for 1 round

Wizard.name: Spell Absorption
Wizard.originalText: Spell Absorption: Absorb a hostile spell, gaining temporary hit points equal to the spell's level.

Wizard.name: Knowledge Transfer
Wizard.originalText: Knowledge Transfer: Temporarily grant an ally knowledge of a skill or language you possess.

Wizard.name: Arcane Sanctuary
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Sanctuary: Create a demiplane of safety for 1 hour where harmful magic cannot function (1/week).

Wizard.name: Core Sync
Wizard.originalText: Core Sync: Spells of your chosen element cost 1 fewer RP at Tier 1–2 (minimum 1 RP); you may change your elemental affinity once per long rest

Wizard.name: Matrix Innovation
Wizard.originalText: Matrix Innovation: Combine aspects of two different spells into one casting.

Wizard.name: Spell Adaptation
Wizard.originalText: Spell Adaptation: Change a spell's damage type or effect type once per short rest.

Wizard.name: Efficient Casting
Wizard.originalText: Efficient Casting: 20% chance to refund the RP spent on a spell immediately after it resolves.

Wizard.name: Arcane Experimentation
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Experimentation: Gain advantage on checks to create new spells or magical items.

Wizard.name: Elemental Affinity
Wizard.originalText: Elemental Affinity: Choose 1 element (Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth); all spells of that element gain +2 DC, +1 damage tier

Wizard.name: Combo Surge
Wizard.originalText: Combo Surge: Casting two different elements in sequence triggers a combo effect

Wizard.name: Cycling Ward
Wizard.originalText: Cycling Ward: Rotate resistance to your cast element (25% reduction)

Wizard.name: Spell Modification
Wizard.originalText: Spell Modification: Alter a prepared spell on the fly, changing its range, duration, or area of effect.

Wizard.name: Arcane Fusion
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Fusion: Combine two spells into a single, more powerful effect.

Wizard.name: Reality Edit
Wizard.originalText: Reality Edit: Temporarily change one aspect of reality in a small area (1/week).

Wizard.name: Flesh Ascendant
Wizard.originalText: Flesh Ascendant: All undead gain +2 HP per Wizard level, if 2+ undead are active, gain +1 AC and Save

Wizard.name: Mind Matrix
Wizard.originalText: Mind Matrix: Your enchantment spells are harder to resist (+2 to save DC).

Wizard.name: Will Domination
Wizard.originalText: Will Domination: Creatures that fail saves against your spells by 5+ are stunned for 1 round.

Wizard.name: Arcane Leech
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Leech: Gain temporary hit points when a creature fails a save against your spells.

Wizard.name: Binding Sigil
Wizard.originalText: Binding Sigil: Mark a creature, giving you advantage on spell attacks against it.

Wizard.name: Corpse Harvest
Wizard.originalText: Corpse Harvest: Raise skeletons/goblins/zombies from slain humanoids

Wizard.name: Ghoul Lash
Wizard.originalText: Ghoul Lash: Minions within 1 tile of each other gain bonus attacks

Wizard.name: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock)
Wizard.originalText: Infernal Pact (Quest-based unlock): Grants Gravebrand: 1d6 necrotic per round, heals caster, overrides corpse resistance

Wizard.name: Mental Binding
Wizard.originalText: Mental Binding: Force a creature to obey a simple command for a short duration.

Wizard.name: Arcane Domination
Wizard.originalText: Arcane Domination: Take control of a creature's actions for 1 minute.

Wizard.name: Mind Prison
Wizard.originalText: Mind Prison: Trap a creature's mind in an illusory reality while controlling its body (1/week).
